exposure: myomectomy for intramural fibroids during caesarean section
Total incision count (one vs. two incisions)
cohort: 63 women who underwent myomectomy during caesarean section and 63 women who underwent caesarean delivery without myomectomy
finding: Myomectomy during caesarean section is generally safe, but larger fibroids and additional incisions increase the risk of haemorrhage.
mod_finding: This study investigated the safety of myomectomy during cesarean section and did not compare different modes of delivery.
